summary:
Turn 11 converted the reproduced exploration into a formal check with an explicit obligation and oracle.

Obligation (new Candidate + claim). C1-recovery-adopts-committed-vector, concern consensus_safety: when recovery runs for instance (Replica, Instance) and a slow-quorum PrepareReply reports that instance COMMITTED with a command vector, the recovering replica must adopt that committed vector rather than continue from its own record and restart phase 1 with a different command. The claim carries scoped grounding (derivation, applicability N=3 with Thrifty and IsLeader false, unresolved items, and an explicit alternative reading for the reviewer: that the local record's new ballot legitimately outranks an older committed vbal), and two implementation bindings locate it: startRecoveryForInstance (the seed and the self PrepareReply's announced vbal) and handlePrepareReply (the element.VBallot >= lb.ballot selection plus the status-based sub-case dispatch).

Check plan and harness. The plan fixes the discriminator and its prefix (peer record prepared COMMITTED with a real PUT, recovering replica holding a default record, real Prepare/PrepareReply delivery through the real wire form), declares the prerequisite alias committed_reply on the canonical peer_committed_reply event, and monitors the resolution event with the prerequisite as admission alias and identity correlation on the instance. The observable property is an event_assertion over the resolution event's adopted_committed field, so a resolution that restarts phase 1 with NOOP after a COMMITTED reply is a complete violating witness rather than a silent difference. Harness legality, applicability, unresolved premises, semantic changes (in-package construction, buffers instead of TCP, direct recovery entry, prepared COMMITTED record) and alternatives are recorded, and the plan leaves harness content to the submitted file as the backend requires.

State of the frontier. The recovery-vbal Candidate now has a fixed requirement, a binding basis and a formal check awaiting the trusted runner and a semantic review; the accept-status Candidate stays open as its own question, and the earlier explained results are untouched. No map object was changed (basis v4), and no requirement, premise or prior observation was weakened.
